title: 第11章 治疗第12章 坚强
content_zh:
“好吧！
算我怕你了。”
小七无奈说道。
随着小七的命令，两个圆球开始变形，表面的金属开始坍塌扩张速度很快，五秒左右两台银白色人形的安保机器人已经站立在了床板前，抬起床板，身体马上悬空，全程几乎没有颠簸，随着一路上机械开门关门，大概有了百八十米过了七八扇门总算是到了飞船的治疗室，把床板放到中间的治疗台上，墙顶伸出一根探针，一道光从头到尾将米莉扫过一遍，医师ai马上汇报说只是血液压迫脑神经致使病人昏迷不醒，虽然病是小病但是需要马上进行开脑手术，否则有可能对脑部造成不可预料的损伤，这一下就算是吉恩在相信科学也有点怕了。
“小七，我们飞船上的ai医师你确定能做这个手术吗？”
毕竟他是从蓝星二十一世纪华夏直接跳到这里的！
在生活的那个时代内科手术就没有几个不危险的！
动到刀子你就要签字～你割个阑尾炎都有可能导致伤口发炎！
“放心吧，用你的话来讲，就是小菜一碟啦，好了医师要准备手术了，你要出去了，拖的越久你得小女朋友越危险～”
说完就把吉恩赶出治疗室。
吉恩紧张的站在外面墙壁马上变的透明，吉恩感觉应该是显影或者投影，小七也识趣的没有说话，治疗室内随着光线变化，完成杀菌，然后又是一阵光线变化，房间里竟然填满了一种像水一样的液体，米莉带着一个呼吸器，人就悬浮在液体里，也没见医师的两条机械臂怎么操作，好像只是环着米莉的头绕了一圈，米莉的头盖骨就被分离开了，米莉的大脑就这样浸泡在液体中还在微微的起伏，随后医师的一条手臂中食指收缩成一根细针，找了下位置角度就插进米莉的脑组织中，来回了三次好像是手术做完了，然后引导着米莉的头盖骨缓缓靠近大脑，然后又是围着米莉的大脑绕一圈，随后液体下降，等米莉再次躺在床上的时候手术已经做完了。
“这么快啊！”
吉恩不由得感叹道！
全程好像就费了四十分钟的样子。
“还好吧，只要是系统中被导入了的手术医师做起来都不费劲。”
小七说道。
“不过看来这个世界确实有些危险，趁她还没醒，我们再去虚拟世界练习下机甲操控吧？等下你回去带一套机甲下去吧。”
小七道，确实一直以来斯凯格丝海港的生活都很平静，也没有什么危险，ai随时监控着吉恩，有危险就传送带走，再说了机甲太强大了，行者号飞船上的机甲可是配备给地仙级别的修真者使用的，如果在吉恩心智不够成熟的时候让他穿戴机甲，也不知道会惹出什么祸害出来，这些都是宪法规定的，有时候没办法，不过因为脱离了联合国的那个宇宙，小七也没有人或者政府监控它，它就可以跟吉恩商量着来，有些事情可以在一定范围内活动。
吉恩看着米莉躺在床上休息，一时半会可能醒不来，就走了。
确实应该训练下机甲操控了！

不说斯凯格丝海港安不安全，就说新大陆那边的治安情况都是个未知数！
再者生活在华夏二十一世纪的青年男性有几个没有一个机甲梦？
“呃，我这是在哪里？利？米拉？你们在吗？”
米莉迷糊着醒来，一手抚这额头，一手撑着这里的身体想要缓缓坐起来，不过尝试了几次都没能成功，浑身无力跟散架了一样！
不过好像周围没有人回应她，只有空旷的房间里回荡着回音，晃了晃头米莉发现自己处在一个银白色的房间里，除了自己躺着的这床好像是床，其它的都是浑然一体，四壁也没有门或者窗。
“哦，恢复的挺快的嘛？”
正当米莉疑惑的时候，一个小女孩的声音从四周响起。
“你好，这是哪里？”
米莉稍微有点清醒，毕竟她也是职业者身体素质不差，不过头还是很疼！
“这里是行者号飞船，你是被吉恩送过来治疗的，因为你身体动过手术，暂时不能离开这间房间，你可以先休息下，等下吉恩忙完了就会过来，你可以称呼我小七，如果有事你可以喊我，我都能听见的。”
小七说道。
艾米莉心想，我怎么回格林帝国了？利与米拉还需要我带人去救他们，该死我记起来了，在路上遇到暴民不敌被人伤了头部，然后呢？是不是利与米拉将自己送回斯凯格丝海港的？小七不说话整个房间静的吓人！
只有米莉自己的心跳声，不过她现在也很疲劳，脑子又难受想了一会后自己又迷迷糊糊睡着了。
“吉恩你的那个女人她醒了。”
吉恩正操控着机甲躲避敌人的攻击，一听本来集中的精神散发了下，被敌人一炮KO了，然后打算退出训练，去看米莉。
“哎哎我还没说完呢，因为做过手术，太疲劳了她又睡着了，不过你也该补充点能量了。”
content_en:
"Okay!
I guess I'm afraid of you. "
Xiao Qi said helplessly.
Following Xiaoqi's command, the two spheres began to deform, and the metal on the surface began to collapse and expand very quickly. In about five seconds, two silver-white humanoid security robots were standing in front of the bed. They lifted the bed and their bodies were immediately suspended in the air. There was almost no bumps in the whole process. As the doors and doors were opened and closed mechanically along the way, they finally arrived at the treatment room of the spacecraft after about 180 meters and seven or eight doors. The bed board was placed on the treatment table in the middle, a probe protruded from the top of the wall, and a ray of light scanned Millie from beginning to end. The doctor AI immediately reported that it was only the blood that compressed the cranial nerves that caused the patient to become comatose. Although the illness was a minor illness, brain surgery was required immediately, otherwise it might cause unpredictable damage to the brain. Even Jean who believed in science was a little scared at this time.
"Xiao Qi, are you sure the AI doctor on our spaceship can do this surgery?"
After all, he jumped here directly from Blue Star 21st Century China!
In that era of life, there were few internal surgeries that were not dangerous!
You have to sign when the knife is used. Even if you get appendicitis, the wound may become inflamed!
"Don't worry, in your words, it's a piece of cake. Now the doctor is going to prepare for the operation. You have to go out. The longer you delay, the more dangerous it will be for your little girlfriend~"
After saying that, he kicked Gene out of the treatment room.
Jean stood nervously outside and the wall immediately became transparent. Jean felt that it should be a development or a projection. Xiao Qi also said nothing in a wise manner. As the light changed in the treatment room, the sterilization was completed, and then there was another light change. The room was actually filled with a water-like liquid. Milly was wearing a respirator, and the person was suspended in the liquid. It was not seen how the doctor's two robotic arms operated. It seemed that they just circled Milly's head. Milly's head The skull bones were separated, and Milly's brain was immersed in the liquid and still rising and falling slightly. Then the doctor's index finger on one arm contracted into a thin needle, found the position and angle, and inserted it into Milly's brain tissue. It went back and forth three times as if the operation was completed, and then guided Milly's skull to slowly approach the brain, and then circled around Milly's brain. Then the liquid dropped, and by the time Milly was lying on the bed again, the operation had been completed.
"So fast!"
Jean couldn't help but sigh!
The whole journey seemed to take only forty minutes.
"It's okay, as long as the surgeon is imported into the system, it won't be difficult for him to do it."
Xiao Qi said.
"But it seems that this world is indeed a bit dangerous. Before she wakes up, let's go to the virtual world to practice controlling the mecha? You can go back and bring a set of mecha with you later."
Xiao Qi said, it is true that life at Skaggs Harbor has always been peaceful, and there is no danger. The AI monitors Jean at all times and teleports him away if there is danger. Besides, the mechas are too powerful. The mechas on the Walker spacecraft are equipped for use by earthly immortal level cultivators. If Jean is not mature enough, When I let him wear a mecha, I don't know what kind of trouble it will cause. These are all stipulated in the constitution, and sometimes there is no way. However, because it is separated from the universe of the United Nations, Xiaoqi has no one or government to monitor it. It can discuss it with Jean, and some things can be carried out within a certain range.
Gene watched Milly lying on the bed to rest. She might not wake up for a while, so she left.
You really should train in mecha control!
Not to mention the safety of Skeggs Harbor, but the security situation in the New World is still unknown!
Furthermore, how many young men living in China in the 21st century do not have a mecha dream?
"Uh, where am I? Leigh? Mira? Are you there?"
Milly woke up in a daze. She touched her forehead with one hand and supported her body with the other hand, trying to sit up slowly. However, she tried a few times.I didn't succeed every time, I felt so weak that I just fell apart!
But it seemed that no one around her responded to her, only echoes echoed in the empty room. Shaking her head, Milly found herself in a silver-white room. Except for the bed she was lying on, which seemed to be a bed, everything else was seamless. There were no doors or windows on the four walls.
"Oh, you recovered pretty quickly?"
Just when Milly was confused, a little girl's voice sounded from all around.
"Hello, where are you?"
Milly is a little awake. After all, she is also a professional and her physical fitness is not bad, but her head still hurts!
"This is the spacecraft Walker. You were sent here for treatment by Jean. Because you have undergone surgery on your body, you cannot leave this room for the time being. You can rest first. Jean will come over when he is done with his work. You can call me Xiaoqi. If you have anything, you can call me and I can hear you."
Xiao Qi said.
Emily thought to herself, why did I return to the Green Empire? Lee and Mira still need me to lead people to rescue them. Damn it, I remembered that I was defeated by a mob on the road and was injured in the head. What next? Was it Leigh and Mira who sent him back to Skaggs Harbor? Xiaoqi didn't say anything, and the whole room was eerily silent!
The only sound was Milly's own heartbeat, but she was also very tired now and her mind was uncomfortable. After thinking for a while, she fell asleep again.
"Jean, that woman of yours is awake."
Gene was controlling the mecha to avoid the enemy's attack. When he heard that his concentrated energy was lost, he was KOed by the enemy with one shot. Then he planned to quit the training and go see Milly.
"Hey, I haven't finished talking yet. She was so tired after the surgery that she fell asleep again, but it's time for you to replenish your energy."
